title: Documentation Build Tools
summary: This module provides hooks and utilities for the MkDocs documentation build process, including code snippet injection, Algolia search indexing preparation, and environment configuration.

nodes.label: MkDocs Build System
nodes.title: MkDocs Build System
nodes.description: The main documentation generation engine that orchestrates the build process and calls various hooks.

nodes.label: Markdown Documentation Files
nodes.title: Markdown Docs
nodes.description: The raw Markdown files that form the content of the documentation.

nodes.label: Source Code Repository
nodes.title: Source Code
nodes.description: Contains the actual code files from which snippets are extracted for documentation.

nodes.label: Generated HTML Documentation
nodes.title: Generated HTML
nodes.description: The final HTML output of the MkDocs build process, which is served to users.

nodes.label: Algolia Search Index JSON
nodes.title: Algolia Index File
nodes.description: The output JSON file containing structured data for Algolia to index, enabling search functionality.

nodes.label: Pre-process Markdown
nodes.title: Markdown Pre-processor
nodes.description: Applies various transformations to Markdown content, including injecting code snippets, before it's converted to HTML. (on_page_markdown)

nodes.label: Inject Code Snippets
nodes.title: Snippet Injector
nodes.description: Scans Markdown content for snippet directives and uses the snippet replacement logic to embed actual code from source files.

nodes.label: Replace Snippet Directive
nodes.title: Snippet Replacer
nodes.description: Core logic for parsing a snippet directive and replacing it with formatted code extracted from a source file.

nodes.label: Parse Snippet Directive
nodes.title: Directive Parser
nodes.description: Extracts attributes like path, title, fragments, and highlights from a Markdown snippet directive string.

nodes.label: Parse Code File Sections
nodes.title: File Section Parser
nodes.description: Reads a source code file and identifies named sections and line ranges for selective extraction.

nodes.label: Format Highlight Lines
nodes.title: Highlight Formatter
nodes.description: Converts internal line range representations into a string format suitable for code block highlighting in documentation.

nodes.label: Process Page Content for Algolia
nodes.title: Algolia Content Processor
nodes.description: Cleans up HTML, extracts sections, and generates structured records for Algolia search based on page content. (on_page_content)

nodes.label: Finalize Algolia Records
nodes.title: Algolia Record Finalizer
nodes.description: Collects all generated Algolia records and writes them to a JSON file after the documentation build is complete. (on_post_build)

nodes.label: Configure Build Environment
nodes.title: Environment Configurer
nodes.description: Modifies the MkDocs build environment, setting global variables and resolving asset paths. (on_env)

groups.label: MkDocs Lifecycle Hooks
groups.title: MkDocs Lifecycle Hooks
groups.description: Components that integrate with and extend the MkDocs documentation build process at various stages.

groups.label: Code Snippet Management
groups.title: Code Snippet Management
groups.description: Handles the parsing of snippet directives in Markdown and the extraction and formatting of corresponding code from source files.

groups.label: Data Sources & Sinks
groups.title: Data Sources & Sinks
groups.description: Represents the various inputs and outputs involved in the documentation generation process.
